'''Scott Taylor'''<ref name="dt-20035">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20035 A dIsTrUpTiOn  (InVaSiOn StYlE)], DeckTech (scott "hjedi" taylor, 17 December 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20035/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20035/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''hjedi'''<ref name="gpn-178">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=178 At Last We Will Have Our Revenge], Game Players Network (hjedi, 8 December 2001), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted a [[Dark]] [[Invasion / In Complete Control|Invasion]] list on DeckTech in December 2001. Taylor also published three constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]] in December 2001.
